style.vernacular: Layered colonial city under Table Mountain: whitewashed Cape Dutch and Cape Georgian houses with gables, green shutters and thatch or slate roofs; narrow flat-fronted Georgian/Victorian rowhouses in Bo-Kaap painted pink, green, blue, yellow and purple on cobbled streets; honey limestone and Table Mountain sandstone Edwardian civic buildings; plain cream-rendered Victorian and Edwardian terraces with iron-lace verandas; 1960s-70s concrete and brick blocks on the Foreshore and glass office towers in the CBD. Corrugated or clay-tile roofs, oaks, stone pines and palms, mountain and fynbos backdrop.
style.ornament: Cape Dutch curved and clock gables with white plaster volutes; green timber shutters and sash windows; Cape Georgian pediments and fanlights; Bo-Kaap multicoloured facades with voorstoep stoeps; cast-iron lace verandas; Edwardian Renaissance civic stonework with clock towers.

sources.what: Whitewashed walls, green shutters/doors, central gables, thatched roofs, H-shaped plans
Brightly coloured houses (pink, red, blue, green, purple), cobbled streets, Cape Dutch/Georgian rowhouses
Edwardian civic building in honey-coloured oolitic limestone from Bath
Fynbos vegetation on the peninsula
